q: The Meghalaya Legislative Assembly recently passed a resolution opposing which activity?
explanation: The Meghalaya Legislative Assembly unanimously passed a resolution opposing uranium exploration and mining in the state. All 60 MLAs supported the resolution.

q: Who introduced the Meghalaya Assembly resolution opposing uranium exploration and mining?
explanation: The resolution opposing uranium exploration and mining was introduced by Meghalaya Chief Minister Conrad K. Sangma.

q: By approximately what percentage did battery-grade lithium carbonate prices decline month-on-month?
explanation: Battery-grade lithium carbonate prices declined by 10.3% month-on-month, averaging around RMB 140,000 per tonne.

q: Lithium carbonate is particularly important in the context of which technology?
explanation: Lithium carbonate is an important battery-grade material and is associated with Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) energy-storage cells.

q: Which United Nations body made observations that India rejected?
explanation: India rejected observations made by the United Nations Committee on the Elimination of Racial Discrimination (UNCERD) following its 11th periodic review in Geneva.

q: HAL and Safran Helicopter Engines have agreed to jointly develop which helicopter engine?
explanation: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) and Safran Helicopter Engines signed an agreement to jointly develop the Aravalli helicopter engine.

q: The proposed Aravalli helicopter engine is designed to fall in which power class?
explanation: The Aravalli engine is designed in the 3,500–4,000 shaft horsepower class for India's future multirole military helicopters.

q: The Aravalli helicopter engine is intended to power which Indian helicopter?
explanation: The Aravalli engine is intended to power HAL's 13-tonne Indian Multi-Role Helicopter (IMRH) and its naval variant, the Deck-Based Multi-Role Helicopter.

q: Where did DRDO conduct the first test of the Military Combat Parachute System (MCPS)?
explanation: DRDO conducted the first test of its indigenous Military Combat Parachute System at the Nyoma-Mudh drop zone in Ladakh.

q: The DRDO Military Combat Parachute System test involved a jump from approximately what altitude?
explanation: The MCPS test involved a jump from an altitude of 22,000 feet above mean sea level.

q: What does SCADA stand for?
explanation: SCADA stands for Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition. It is an important technology used in power-grid control and monitoring.

q: By which year did a Central Electricity Authority committee recommend ending India's dependence on imported SCADA technology?
explanation: The committee recommended that India should end its dependence on imported SCADA technology by 2030 to address supply-chain and cybersecurity concerns.

q: Who won the FIDE-rated rapid chess championship mentioned in the current affairs?
explanation: Seventeen-year-old Apoorv Kamble won the FIDE-rated rapid chess championship with 8.5 points out of nine rounds.

q: How many points did Apoorv Kamble score in nine rounds?
explanation: Apoorv Kamble secured 8.5 points out of nine rounds in the FIDE-rated rapid chess championship.

q: What is the reported prize-money pool of the US Open 2026?
explanation: According to the supplied current-affairs material, the US Open 2026 has a record prize-money pool of $108 million.

q: The Nepal flash floods mentioned in the current affairs occurred in which river system?
explanation: The catastrophic floods occurred in the Bhote Koshi–Trishuli–Narayani river system and highlighted the vulnerability of the Himalayan region to compound hazards.

q: Which of the following is identified as a key strategy for climate-proofing India's food system?
explanation: Crop diversification is one of the key strategies identified for building a climate-resilient food system, along with resilient storage and climate-smart farming.

q: Bihar's Vidya Sathi mobile application primarily aims to support students in which classes?
explanation: The Vidya Sathi application provides continuous academic support to students in Classes 9–12 across model schools in Bihar.

q: The Vidya Sathi initiative in Bihar is intended to support approximately how many students?
explanation: The initiative is intended to provide academic support to over 3 lakh students across 700 model schools in all 38 districts of Bihar.

q: Under the UP Shadi Anudan Yojana, eligible families can receive financial assistance of:
explanation: According to the supplied material, eligible financially weaker families can receive ₹20,000 towards marriage-related expenses under the UP Shadi Anudan Yojana.

q: According to the supplied current-affairs material, when did Balen Shah assume office as Prime Minister of Nepal?
explanation: The supplied material states that Balen (Balendra) Shah assumed office as Prime Minister of Nepal on March 27, 2026.

q: Before becoming Prime Minister of Nepal, Balen Shah served as:
explanation: Before becoming Prime Minister, Balendra Shah served as the Mayor of Kathmandu.

q: The Global Drought Resilience Architecture was launched at which event?
explanation: According to the supplied material, the Global Drought Resilience Architecture was introduced at UNCCD COP17.

q: Which of the following is included in the Global Drought Resilience Architecture?
explanation: The initiative includes the Drought Resilience Index (DRI) and the Drought Resilience Investment Facility (DRIF), promoting proactive drought preparedness.

q: Land subsidence in Uttarakhand's Bageshwar district is primarily associated with which activity according to the supplied material?
explanation: The supplied material links severe land subsidence in Bageshwar district to rampant underground and open-cast soapstone mining, which has caused ground fissures and damage to homes.
